responsibilities: As a mid-level Analytics Engineer in our Data Analytics team, you will bridge the gap between underlying data pipelines and key business insights.
You will spend roughly 60% of your time on data modeling and 40% on BI, dashboards, and analytics, turning complex data into actionable insights for media owners, DSPs, and internal stakeholders.
You will write high-performing SQL queries, optimize dbt models, and translate technical metrics into clear business narratives that empower colleagues to self-serve their data needs.

Your immediate focus will be supporting our exciting migration from SnowFlake to ClickHouse, followed by opportunities in 2027 to help build semantic layers and introduce further AI and advanced analytics.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour phrases ('robust data models', 'deliver reliable data', 'keen eye for detail') sit beside velocity phrases ('agile, fast-paced environment', 'two-week agile sprints', 'learn new tools quickly') in roughly equal weight.
evidence.domain_risk: transforming how media buyers and sellers connect globally
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Programmatic out-of-home advertising marketplace with no financial reporting or regulatory language.

evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A Data Analytics team with dbt Cloud, ThoughtSpot and data engineers already exists and is migrating its warehouse.
